messages:
Ava: Heads-up — planning the launch newsletter that ties the benchmark blog + webinar registration. Need final cadence and segmentation before we lock send windows.
Sam: thanks — can we do a two-send cadence? day 0 launch + day 4 reminder for non-openers.
Priya: +1. Also want a short narrative block that highlights the benchmark takeaways (latency/cost wins) and a CTA to register for the webinar. Keep it <150 words.
Lukas: deliverability note — avoid heavy >3 links in the html. route trial accounts through the dedicated streaming template.
Marta: Sales ask — include an enterprise lead flag in the link params for anyone from company domains >500 employees, so we can route to AE queue.
Ava: segmentation proposal: 1) Existing newsletter subs (general) 2) Trial users (product engagement >3 sessions last 7d) 3) Enterprise prospects (lead score >=60) 4) Inactive signups (opened 0 marketing emails in 90d)
Sam: For subject line test — can we A/B two variants across 25% each and keep 50% control?
Priya: Suggested subjects:
```
A: "New benchmarks: 3x inference speed, half the cost — see how"
B: "How we cut inference cost without losing quality — results + webinar"
```
Sam: good. What about preview text? keep it action-oriented: "Join our benchmark deep-dive + live Q&A"
Marta: Routing: enterprise clicks -> /enterprise-webinar?utm_segment=enterprise ; trial clicks -> /trial-webinar?utm_segment=trial ; general -> /webinar?utm_segment=general
Ava: Campaign-bot, please create a campaign draft with those links and set the send windows to PST-friendly times (10am / 2pm RECIPIENT TZ fallback).
campaign-bot: created campaign draft id 8765, scheduled test send to internal list tomorrow 09:30 PST.
Lukas: Quick ops checklist: canonical tracking params, one-pixel open tracking, unblock images whitelist for hubspot. Also ensure AMP blocks disabled for enterprise segment.
Priya: Body outline I plan to send to copy review: 1) 1-line hook referencing benchmark delta 2) 3 bullets of findings (latency, cost, reliability) 3) Quote from benchmarking author 4) CTA to register 5) calendar add link
Sam: CTA variations — Primary: "Register for live webinar" Secondary (for trial cohort): "See migration guide + trial benefits"
Ava: Send windows: initial send Thu 2024-06-13 10:00 PST, reminder Mon 2024-06-17 11:00 PST. Is that okay?
Marta: Works. Can we do an SMS nudge for enterprise registrants 1 hour before the webinar?
Lukas: need opt-in flag for SMS, only send if phone on file and consent=true.
Priya: I'll drop final copy by EOD. Ava, can you confirm the list exports for each segment so we don't double-send?
Ava: yep, I'll upload deduped lists to campaign draft and confirm.
Sam: measurement: open rate, CTR, webinar reg conversion, and post-webinar MQL conversion (30d). Also track cost-per-reg by segment.
Ava: agreed. Last asks: include a short one-click feedback link in the post-webinar follow-up to surface any quality regressions from attendees.
Marta: noted — AE handoff email template ready.
Ava: Thanks team — final copy review at 16:00, then we lock. :party_parrot:
